rationale: uswin-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=200, epochs=40, batch_size=2, lr=0.0002, uswin_c=32, swin_window=8, swin_heads=8, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=ITER-6 (breast-ct-claude-agentic-uswin-search-20260703-01). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) READ iter-1..5: hr 0.6490(ep8)/0.8193(ep40,win8,h4)/0.8092(win16,ep32)/0.8208(h8,ep38,BEST)/0.8136(lr4e-4,ep39). val_ssim plateaued at 0.9977 for iters 2/4/5; train loss drove to ~1e-6 (full convergence) every run. iter-4 BEST = c24/win8/h8/ep40/lr2e-4 hr=0.820804. (2) FAILURE MODE: uswin_c=24 is CAPACITY-SATURATED. Evidence: attention-shape levers (window iter-3, heads iter-4) and the optimization lever (lr iter-5) all failed to move hr past ~0.821, while loss fully converged to ~1e-6 -> the model has learned all it can REPRESENT at 24 base channels. The untested lever is raw model CAPACITY (base channel width). (3) ONE KNOB: uswin_c 24 -> 32 (1.33x base width, ~1.78x params); hold everything else at the iter-4 BEST (epochs=40, bs=2, lr=2e-4, swin_window=8, swin_heads=8, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). I do NOT also cut epochs -> stays ONE knob; the max_train_s=1000 backstop (which already fired at ep32/38/39 in iters 3/4/5) will cap training at whatever epoch count fits, giving an honest budget-constrained capacity test. (4) HYPOTHESIS: hr 0.821 is representation-limited at c=24; widening base channels 24->32 raises model capacity and lifts hr above 0.821 EVEN with fewer epochs (backstop ~ep22-24 at ~1.78x per-epoch cost), because the c24 runs were capacity- not epoch-limited (loss already ~1e-6 by ep40). FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr <= 0.821 at c=32, either (a) the epoch cut from the backstop outweighs the capacity gain, or (b) 0.82 is a data/geometry ceiling not a capacity one -> iter-7 either restores epochs by cutting elsewhere (bs, or accept fewer epochs is fine) or tests DEPTH instead of width. (5) HARD 20-min budget honored via max_train_s=1000 backstop (fires like iters 3/4/5); val_n=200 = whole val pool; PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True guards OOM at the larger c=32 model. (6) I self-drive: dispatch iter-7 when iter-6 lands, continuing to iter-20.
